newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares rise, trend seen holding.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares rise, trend seen holding.

text.p: Austrian shares recovered from earlier lows to close higer on Monday, and traders said the positive trend was likely to hold if volumes picked up.
"If we see some good volumes tomorrow and Wall Street doesn't fall, then it could go strongly higher," said a trader.

The ATX index of 21 blue chips rose 13.04 points or 1.07 percent to close at 1,237.01, up from the day's low of 1,217.15. Among its constituents, 13 gainers outnumbered six losers, two issues closed unchanged.
Traders said buying was selected and concentrated in heavily weighted index shares.
Brewery group Oesterreichische Brau AG topped the day's gainers, rising five percent or 36.50 schillings to close at 766.50 schillings.
Elsewhere, chemical and energy group OMV rose 12 schillings to 1,412. Technology group VA Technologie rose 40 schillings to close at 1,833.0
The broad-based Vienna bourse index rose 4.54 points or one percent to 458.34.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX futures for March delivery were up ten points at 1,236.5.
